KKA0299-CKS.lead: Curved, serrated shears for fish, chicken and prep-table trimming.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Black Handle Curved Kitchen Scissor is a 24 cm pair of kitchen shears with curved stainless steel blades, one of them edged with fine serrations. The listing photos show it trimming fish fins, cleaning prawns, cutting chicken and portioning raw meat on a board.

One black handle is a straight bar that fills the palm and the other is a wide loop for the fingers, so the scissor stays steady when working through poultry skin or tough fins. A small latch near the pivot holds it shut between jobs, keeping the points safe in a crowded utensil drawer.
b: Curved Blades: The bend lets the tips follow the outline of a fish or bird while removing fat, fins or skin.
Serrated Edge: Fine teeth on one side grip wet, slippery food so it stays in the cut.
Size and Build: About 24 cm long and 7 cm across the handles, with 2Cr13 stainless steel marked on the blade and ABS on the grips.
Blade Latch: A clasp near the pivot locks the shears closed for storage.
KKA0299-CKS.suit: Seafood cleaning, poultry trimming, meat portioning, snipping herbs and opening food packets in restaurant, hotel and catering kitchens.
KKA0299-CKS.care: Wash by hand in hot, soapy water, opening the scissor wide to reach around the pivot, and dry fully before latching it. Store with the points closed and away from the edge of the worktop. Cut only food and packaging, never wire or metal ties, to protect the edge.
KKA0299-CKS.title: Curved Kitchen Scissors, Black Handle
KKA0299-CKS.meta: Black Handle Curved Kitchen Scissor, 24 cm, with a serrated stainless blade for fish, prawns and chicken. Order from Kitchenary Kart for your prep table.

KKA0300-BMWSB.lead: A serving basket for fries and starters, with a ring for the dip.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Black Thick Metal Wire Starter Basket with Side Holder Rack is a square black basket for bringing fries, onion rings, nuggets or pretzels to the table. A round ring on one side carries a small dip cup, so the sauce sits right next to the food instead of on a separate plate.

The open grid lets steam escape rather than trapping it under hot fried food. On the opposite side, a long looped handle makes the basket easy to set down in front of a guest, and the fryer-basket look suits pub and burger-joint menus.
b: Thick Wire Build: Black metal wire forms the walls and floor, giving a sturdy, see-through serving basket.
Side Holder Ring: The ring takes a small dip or sauce cup; the listing name covers the basket and this holder.
Dimensions: About 12.6 cm across the top and 10 cm tall, reaching 21.7 cm with the handle.
Loop Handle: Sized for a firm hold when lifting a full portion off the pass.
KKA0300-BMWSB.suit: Serving French fries, onion rings, wings, pretzels and burger sides in pubs, bars, QSR outlets and cafés.
KKA0300-BMWSB.care: Scrub gently with a soft brush and dish soap, working between the wires, then rinse and dry straight away. Avoid steel wool and harsh scourers on the black coating. A sheet of greaseproof paper under oily food makes cleanup quicker.
KKA0300-BMWSB.title: Wire Starter Basket with Side Dip Holder
KKA0300-BMWSB.meta: Black wire starter basket with a side ring for a dip cup, 12.6 cm square, for fries, onion rings and pretzels. Buy it at Kitchenary Kart for table service.

KKA0301-DKT.lead: Big-digit minute and second timer for the cooking line.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Digital Kitchen Timer is a compact 7 x 6.5 cm timer with a large LCD that reads in minutes and seconds, up to 99:59. Three buttons do everything: MIN and SEC set the time, and ST/SP starts or stops the count.

Pressing MIN and SEC together clears the display for the next round, so a cook can reset it with one hand between fryer loads, dough proofs or tea brews. The white body with blue keys stands upright on a table, as the photos show, and takes up little room on a shelf near the stove.
b: Large Display: Tall digits show minutes and seconds, readable from across a busy kitchen.
Three-Button Setup: MIN, SEC and START/STOP keys, with MIN and SEC together marked as reset.
Long Range: Counts up to 99 minutes 59 seconds, from short fry cycles through to longer proofs and braises.
Compact Body: Roughly 7 cm wide and 6.5 cm tall.
KKA0301-DKT.suit: Timing fries, pasta, dough proofing, chai and coffee brews, marinades and oven batches in restaurants, bakeries and cafés.
KKA0301-DKT.care: Wipe with a dry or lightly damp cloth; never rinse it under the tap or leave it where oil or water can splash it. Keep it off hot surfaces and away from open flame. Replace the battery when the digits start to fade.
KKA0301-DKT.title: Digital Kitchen Timer with Large Display
KKA0301-DKT.meta: Digital Kitchen Timer with a big minute-second LCD that counts to 99:59 and resets with two buttons. Order from Kitchenary Kart for your cooking line.

KKA0302-DKBB.lead: Knead a large batch of atta without flour on the worktop or sticky hands.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Dough Kneading / Atta Mixing Bag - Big is a soft silicone pouch for mixing flour and water and kneading it through the bag wall. Add both, close the neck with the tie strap, then press and fold from the outside until the dough comes together.

The bigger size is meant for larger quantities in roti, paratha and puri kitchens. Because everything stays sealed inside, the counter stays clean, and the kneaded ball can rest in the same bag before it is divided.
b: Silicone Pouch: Flexible silicone lets you work the mix by hand through the bag.
Tie Strap Closure: A strap seals the neck so flour and water stay inside while kneading.
Big Size: Made for larger batches when rotis and parathas are rolled in bulk.
Rest in the Bag: Leave the finished dough closed up so its surface stays moist until rolling.
KKA0302-DKBB.suit: Kneading atta for roti, chapati, paratha and puri, plus pizza and bread doughs, in restaurant, dhaba, canteen and catering kitchens.
KKA0302-DKBB.care: Turn the bag inside out and wash it in hot water with a little dish soap, then let it dry fully before storing. Keep it away from knives, grater edges and open flame. Store it flat or hang it by the corner hole.
KKA0302-DKBB.title: Silicone Atta Kneading Bag - Big
KKA0302-DKBB.meta: Big silicone dough kneading bag with tie strap: mix atta and water, knead through the bag, keep counters clean. Shop at Kitchenary Kart for bulk roti prep.

KKA0303-DKBS.lead: A smaller silicone bag for quick, mess-free roti batches.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Dough Kneading / Atta Mixing Bag - Small lets you mix and knead inside a closed silicone pouch, so no flour dust settles on the prep table. Pour in the atta and water, seal the top, and squeeze and fold the bag until you have a smooth ball.
The small size fits short runs: a single order of puris, a few parathas at a café, or a trial batch at a bakery. It rinses quickly and hangs from its corner hole between shifts.
b: Tie Strap Closure: A strap seals the neck so flour and water stay inside while kneading.
Small Size: Handles modest quantities for à la carte service and small-batch prep.
Printed Guides: Circle markings on the silicone show when the bag lies flat.
Hanging Hole: A hole at one corner for drying it on a hook.
KKA0303-DKBS.suit: Small batches of chapati, puri, kulcha or pizza dough in cafés, cloud kitchens, home bakeries and staff canteens.
KKA0303-DKBS.care: Scrape out any leftovers, wash the bag inside and out in soapy water, and leave it to air-dry on a hook. Do not cut on it or let it touch a hot tawa.
KKA0303-DKBS.title: Silicone Dough Kneading Bag - Small
KKA0303-DKBS.meta: Small silicone atta mixing bag with tie strap for mess-free kneading of roti, puri and pizza dough. Buy from Kitchenary Kart for quick small batches.

KKA0305-BNPS3L.lead: A wheeled three-level rack for newspapers and menus in lobbies and waiting areas.
p: The Kitchenary Kart MS Black Magazine/News Paper Stand 3 Levels with Back Support & Rotating Wheels is a free-standing mild steel rack with three mesh pockets that hold papers upright and face-out. A curved rear frame supports each level, and a solid panel crowns the top.

Four castor wheels let staff roll it from the reception desk to a lounge or push it aside for floor cleaning. At 118 cm tall, it puts daily newspapers, magazines, brochures or takeaway menus within easy reach of guests waiting for a table.
b: Three Mesh Levels: Perforated metal pockets keep papers on display without slipping out.
Back Support: The curved rear frame holds each level at an angle so covers face the reader.
Rotating Wheels: Four castors for moving the stand across the floor.
Footprint: About 118 cm high, 64 cm wide and 34 cm deep.
KKA0305-BNPS3L.suit: Hotel lobbies, restaurant waiting areas, café reading corners, salons, clinics and office receptions.
KKA0305-BNPS3L.care: Dust the mesh with a dry cloth and wipe marks with a damp one; skip abrasive pads that could scratch the black finish. Park it on level flooring and load heavier bundles low so it stays steady.
KKA0305-BNPS3L.title: Magazine & Newspaper Stand, 3 Levels
KKA0305-BNPS3L.meta: MS black 3-level magazine and newspaper stand on castor wheels, 118 cm tall, for hotel lobbies and restaurant waiting areas. Available at Kitchenary Kart.

KKA0306-PCGNH.lead: A clear stand that sets GN pans over a chilled well at the counter.
p: The Kitchenary Kart PC GN Pan Holder - 6.75L (Only Holder) is a transparent polycarbonate tub with a sloped top frame that holds a row of gastronorm pans tilted toward the user. The space underneath can be filled with crushed ice, as the photos show, to keep cut fruit, garnishes and toppings chilled.

This listing is for the holder alone: the containers and lids seen in the pictures are not part of it, so pair it with the ones your kitchen already uses. The angled front puts each compartment within easy reach from a bar or salad station.
b: Clear Body: See-through polycarbonate shows the chill level and the food from every side.
Sloped Top Frame: Tilts the pans forward for easy scooping during service.
Ice Well: The deep tub underneath takes crushed ice for chilled display.
Measurements: About 53 cm long, 25 cm deep and 22 cm high.
KKA0306-PCGNH.suit: Bar garnish stations, salad and fruit counters, sandwich lines, and dessert or ice-cream topping bars.
KKA0306-PCGNH.care: Wash with mild detergent and a soft sponge; polycarbonate scratches and clouds under scourers, solvents or strong cleaners. Drain melted ice after each service and dry the tub before stacking.
KKA0306-PCGNH.title: Polycarbonate GN Pan Holder (Holder Only)
KKA0306-PCGNH.meta: Clear polycarbonate GN pan holder, 53 x 25 x 22 cm, with a sloped top and ice well below for garnish and salad counters. Holder only, at Kitchenary Kart.
conflicts: Capacity: listing name says 6.75L, listing capacity field says 6.5L; photos show no capacity figure (holder measures about 53 x 25 x 22 cm). No capacity written in the copy.

KKA0307-BHSSFFS.lead: A wide steel scoop for lifting fries and griddle food in one pass.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Premium Black Handle SS French Fries Shovel is a stainless steel scoop with a flat, wide front edge and raised walls, made to slide under a heap of fries and carry it to the box or plate. The listing photos also show it clearing fried rice, hash browns and sautéed vegetables off a flat-top griddle.
Its black handle sits on a raised steel stem, which keeps the hand above the hot surface while the blade lies flat. A hole at the grip end lets you hang it beside the fryer or griddle station.
b: Wide Front Edge: A 19 cm flat lip slides under loose food without scattering it.
Raised Walls: Walls about 4 cm high at the back and sides hold a large portion while you move it.
Overall Size: Around 38.2 cm long, with the handle rising 8.8 cm above the scoop.
Riveted Stem: Three rivets fix the stem to the scoop body.
KKA0307-BHSSFFS.suit: Portioning French fries, wedges and fried snacks, and scooping fried rice, hash browns or vegetables from a griddle at QSR outlets, cafés and burger joints.
KKA0307-BHSSFFS.care: Wash after every shift with hot water and detergent, then dry at once to avoid water spots on the steel. Keep the black handle away from open flame and hot oil. Take care with the thin front edge when wiping.
KKA0307-BHSSFFS.title: SS French Fries Shovel, Black Handle
KKA0307-BHSSFFS.meta: Stainless steel French fries shovel with a 19 cm wide edge, raised walls and black riveted handle, for fries and griddle food. Shop at Kitchenary Kart.

KKA0308-SS2.1GPBO.lead: Crush garlic and open bottle caps with one hand tool.
p: The Kitchenary Kart SS 2 in 1 Garlic Press with Bottle Opener - White Handle has a perforated steel chamber that turns peeled cloves into a fine crush when the two handles are squeezed together. Near the hinge, a cut-out in the steel plate works as a bottle opener.

Long white handles with red trim give good leverage, so crushing several cloves for a tadka, marinade or garlic butter takes little effort. Each handle end has a slot for hanging the press on a rail beside the prep station.
b: Perforated Chamber: Holes in the steel hopper push the cloves out as an even crush.
Bottle Opener: A notch at the hinge end lifts crown caps on soda and soft-drink bottles.
Lever Handles: Long white grips with red ends multiply hand pressure.
Hanging Slots: Openings at the handle tips for hook storage.
KKA0308-SS2.1GPBO.suit: Crushing garlic for tadka, marinades, chutneys, dips and garlic bread in restaurant kitchens, cafés and bars, plus opening bottled drinks at the counter.
KKA0308-SS2.1GPBO.care: Rinse right after pressing, before the pulp dries in the holes, and push out any bits with a small brush. Wash in warm soapy water and dry the hinge area fully.
KKA0308-SS2.1GPBO.title: 2-in-1 SS Garlic Press & Bottle Opener
KKA0308-SS2.1GPBO.meta: SS 2-in-1 garlic press with bottle opener and white lever handles, for crushing garlic for tadka and marinades. Order from Kitchenary Kart for your prep line.

KKA0309-SSCS.lead: Six bent steel straws and a cleaning brush for reusable drink service.
p: The Kitchenary Kart SS Curved Straw 6mm - 7pp (6 Straw + 1 Brush Cleaner) is a seven-piece set: six stainless steel straws with a bend near the top and one wire brush for cleaning inside them. Each straw is 21.5 cm long and 6 mm wide, shown in the photos with fresh juice and fruit mocktails.

Reusable straws cut down on single-use plastic at juice bars, cafés and poolside service, and the bend lets guests sip without tilting a tall glass. The 23 cm brush runs through the full length of each one so pulp and syrup do not build up inside.
b: Set of 7: Six curved straws plus one cleaner.
Straw Size: 21.5 cm long with a 6 mm diameter.
Cleaning Brush: 23 cm long with a looped end for hanging.
Bent Top: The angle near the mouth end makes drinking from tall glasses comfortable.
KKA0309-SSCS.suit: Serving juices, mocktails, lemonades, cold coffee and shakes in cafés, juice bars, hotels and resort bars.
KKA0309-SSCS.care: Push the cleaner through each straw under warm running water with a drop of soap after every use, rinse, and stand them upright to drain. Avoid very hot drinks, since steel warms up quickly.
KKA0309-SSCS.title: SS Curved Straws 6mm, Set of 6 + Brush
KKA0309-SSCS.meta: Set of six 21.5 cm stainless steel curved straws, 6 mm wide, with a cleaning brush, for juices and mocktails. Buy reusable straws at Kitchenary Kart.

KKA0310-SGH.lead: A pistol-grip airbrush for shading cakes and fine decorative work.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Spray Gun for Cake/Art/Tattoo Making - Heavy is a trigger-operated airbrush with a black pistol grip and a chrome metal body. Squeezing the trigger releases a fine mist from the nozzle for smooth shading on fondant, buttercream and stencilled cake designs.

The photos show screw-on cups and a loose needle with the gun, plus an air fitting at the base of the handle. It runs on compressed air from a separate compressor. Beyond the bakery, the same tool is shown for tattoo artwork, nail designs, model painting and craft projects.
b: Trigger Action: A full-hand hold and front trigger keep the spray steady over long sessions.
Metal Body: Chrome-finished barrel and tip.
Colour Cups: Screw-on metal cups hold small amounts of edible colour or paint.
Air Inlet: A threaded fitting under the grip connects to the compressor hose.
KKA0310-SGH.suit: Cake decorating and colour shading in bakeries and patisseries, plus airbrush art, temporary tattoo work, nail art and model painting.
KKA0310-SGH.care: Keep one gun for edible colours only and never share it with paints, inks or cosmetics. Flush clean water through it after each session until the spray runs clear, then clean the nozzle and needle gently. Point the nozzle away from faces while testing, and handle the needle tip with care as it bends easily.
KKA0310-SGH.title: Heavy Airbrush Spray Gun, Pistol Grip
KKA0310-SGH.meta: Heavy pistol-grip airbrush spray gun with metal body and colour cups for cake shading, art and airbrush tattoos; runs off a compressor. At Kitchenary Kart.
conflicts: Listing name spells 'Tatoo' (typo for 'tattoo'); the copy uses the corrected 'Tattoo' in the product name. Photos do show airbrush tattoo use, so the word stays. Please correct the listing name.

KKA0311-SGL.lead: A slim pen-style airbrush in a fitted case, for fine detail on cakes.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Spray Gun for Cake/Art/Tattoo Making - Lite is a pen-style airbrush with a gravity-feed cup on top and a control button above the grip. Held like a pen, it lays down thin lines and soft gradients for sugar flowers, lettering and stencil work on cakes.

It is shown packed in a foam-lined case with a clear lid, alongside a plastic dropper, a small spanner and an air adaptor. Like any airbrush it needs a separate compressor to run; the pictures also show it used for nail designs, temporary body art and make-up.
b: Pen-Style Body: A slim barrel held like a pen for close, detailed work.
Top Colour Cup: The cup sits above the nozzle so colour flows down by gravity.
Fitted Case: A foam-lined box with a clear lid keeps the gun and small parts together.
Small Parts Shown: Dropper for filling, a spanner and an air adaptor.
KKA0311-SGL.suit: Fine cake detailing, lettering and sugar-flower shading in home and commercial bakeries, along with nail art, temporary tattoos and make-up.
KKA0311-SGL.care: Reserve this gun for food colours if you decorate cakes with it. After each use, spray clean water through it until the mist runs clear, wipe the cup, and pack it back into its case. Strip the nozzle only with the supplied spanner, and handle the needle tip with care as it bends easily.
KKA0311-SGL.title: Lite Airbrush Spray Gun with Storage Case
KKA0311-SGL.meta: Lite pen-style airbrush spray gun with top colour cup and fitted case, for fine cake detail, nail art and body art. Needs a compressor. From Kitchenary Kart.
conflicts: Listing name spells 'Tatoo' (typo for 'tattoo'); the copy uses the corrected 'Tattoo' in the product name. Photos show temporary body-art use, so the word stays. Please correct the listing name.

KKA0312-WHMBPP.lead: Press round, even burger patties by hand, one after another.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Wooden Handle Manual Burger/Patty Press is a two-piece hand tool: a round base dish holds the mince and a flat plate on a short handle pushes it into an even disc. Both faces carry raised ridges that mark the patty with grill-style lines.

Every patty comes out the same diameter, and filling the dish to the same level each time keeps thickness even, so cooking times on the griddle stay predictable. It shapes chicken or mutton mince as well as paneer and aloo tikki mixes.
b: Patty Size: About 12 cm across, with a 2.1 cm deep base dish.
Wooden Handle: A 60 mm knob gives a firm grip for pressing down.
Ridged Faces: Raised lines on both parts leave grill marks.
Two-Piece Design: Base and press separate for loading, lifting out the finished round and washing.
KKA0312-WHMBPP.suit: Shaping burger patties, aloo tikkis and kebab rounds in burger outlets, QSR counters, cafés and home kitchens.
KKA0312-WHMBPP.care: Hand wash both parts with a mild detergent and dry at once. Keep the handle out of soaking water and the dishwasher, and rub it with a little cooking oil now and then so it does not dry out. A square of butter paper above and below the mince helps the patty release.
KKA0312-WHMBPP.title: Manual Burger Patty Press, Wooden Handle
KKA0312-WHMBPP.meta: Wooden handle manual burger patty press, 12 cm, with ridged base and plate for even patties and aloo tikkis. Shop at Kitchenary Kart for your burger line.
conflicts: Material: listing material field says 'Wooden', but photos show only the handle is wood; the press plate and base dish are grey metal. Body material left out of the copy.
